Gold Ship stands up and appears on screen again
Leave covering your rear to me... baby!
Damn it, looks like there's no safe haven anywhere around here...!

Gold Ship pointed right at me!
While I was at a loss for how to respond—

And while we're at it, flowers bloomed, trees flourished,
and the birds even started humming! Truly a feat worthy of Lord Golshi~!

I am the Umamusume God, Golshia.
To you kindhearted souls, I shall bestow my divine power.
—Get down!!
But we can't get back to the fortress without crossing that pit of lava...!

The park is safe, the culprit's been caught,
Golshi-chan is now a god, and world peace has been achieved!
Justice... PREVAILS!!

Hah, leave it to me! You come along too, Trainer!
If push comes to shove, my Gol-Gol Martial Arts will split the earth in two...!

Just for today, I felt like I was actually able
to keep up with Gold Ship...!

Startled by Gold Ship's sudden shouting,
I instinctively flinched.

Yeah, that's right! You're Golshi-neechan's Trainer, aren't you?
Show us something cool!
You gotta say something back, or you'll lose!
The culprit who shot me is... YOU, YOU BASTARD!

Hell yeah! Right now,
our combat power is over 5,640,000...!

Don't try to look, feel it!
Don't think, feel! You're my Trainer, aren't you?!
G-Golshi-neechan?!

B-But as we are now, we're no match for them!
Fall back, everyone!

It seemed Gold Ship was playing with the neighborhood kids.
Before I knew it, I had been dragged into it as well...

Heh, you've finally revealed your true colors...!
Those 30 purple antennae sprouting from your head are all the proof I need!
There it is! It's Great Detective Golshi!

Mmh! Mmmmh! Mmmmmh!
—My 5.64-million-IQ emerald brain cells just had a Gol-tastic epiphany!
What do we do...? We're totally cornered...!?
No, the real question is... which one of us is actually cornered—?!
You come too! Rendezvous in three seconds! See ya!

I-It's true!
I feel like we can't lose now...!

Alright! That should've sparked it up inside you guys too!
The almighty divine power of an Umamusume...!

Well, duh! There's no way in hell I'd do anything boring,
not even for a fraction of a millisecond!
Oh, that reminds me! I gotta go finish drawing that Nazca Line in the schoolyard from yesterday!

Hey you, keep daydreaming and you'll get caught in the blast!
Danger! Danger!
Awesome! You're so cool, Golshi-neechan!
Gold Ship suddenly collapsed right in the middle of the sandbox!
(Thud!)

Alright, let's move, troops!
Yours truly, Golshi-chan, will take up the rear!

At this rate, this case will remain an unsolved mystery forever.
But don't you worry... leave it to the Great Detective Golshi-chan!
No way... Open your eyes, Golshi-neechan!

Urgh... looks like I'm a goner...
To think I'd get taken out in a place like this...
I see... Instead of constantly letting her drag me around, maybe I should just turn off my brain and play along with all my might, like these kids...?!
Hooray! That's Golshi-neechan for you!
GYAAAAAAAH!

There's no way we'd lose to the likes of you!
Prepare yourself! This is for Golshi-chan—!
Besides, your vibe wasn't half bad today either!
It's Golcia, the one said to perform miracles a hundred times a year!

Golshi-neechan, we can't go any further!
Let's head back to the jungle gym fortress!

Hey, Trainer! That's a lava zone right there!
Watch where you're walkin'!

You guys... gotta stay strong... even without me...!
—*collapses*

—The crime scene is a locked room, and the murder weapon is nowhere to be found.
Every suspect has an ironclad alibi.

One day off,
as I happened to be walking past a park—

I had absolutely no idea what was going on...
but rolling with Gold Ship's antics turned out to be surprisingly fun.

............
Yeah, keeping up with her might still be a long way off!

*pant*... *pant*...!
To think you'd chase us all the way out here...!

And so, led by a fired-up Gold Ship and the children,
I ended up having to cross the sandbox, but—
Yahoo! Mission accomplished, mission accomplished!
